title: BJP in tandem with BRS to obstruct Telangana’s development: Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy
points: Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy is a politician.
He accused the BJP and BRS of stopping progress in Telangana.
The criticism highlights ongoing political tensions in the state.

title: Police withdraw arrangements complying with prohibitory order against Sonam Wangchuk in Leh
points: Police in Leh withdrew restrictions against activist Sonam Wangchuk.
Authorities denied claims that he was kept under house arrest.
The events occurred amid ongoing concerns regarding his public movements.

title: Srikakulam releases 15,440 cusecs as inflows moderate after cyclone floods
points: Srikakulam discharged 15,440 cusecs of water from its water bodies.
Inflows have moderated compared to the one lakh cusecs seen after the recent cyclone.
The administration is monitoring the situation following the destruction in Ichchapuram.

title: Strict action against drug peddlers to begin now, says U.P. CM Yogi
points: UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced strict action against drug peddlers.
He warned that anyone harming the careers of youth will face severe consequences.
The government intends to destroy the network of those involved in the drug trade.

title: One dies, four injured after a car plunges into gorge in Yercaud
points: A car fell into a 100-foot-deep gorge in Yercaud, Tamil Nadu.
The accident occurred at 10:30 p.m. on the Yercaud-Kuppanur Ghat Road.
One person died and four others were injured in the incident.

title: Russia dusts off its pre-war demands as the U.S. raises discussing European security at Ukraine talks
points: Russia is revisiting pre-war demands regarding European security.
Donald Trump's envoys proposed discussing new security arrangements for Europe.
Ukraine and NATO allies fear these talks could weaken Western regional security.

title: Key takeaways from the Quad, ASEAN-India, and East Asia Summits in Manila | Explained
points: PM Modi attended the Quad, ASEAN-India, and East Asia Summits in Manila.
The visits focused on deepening multilateral cooperation.
India aims to work more closely with ASEAN as global powers shift toward unilateral policies.

title: Iraq fire at Basra power station kills at least four, injures 30
points: A fire at the Hartha power station in Basra, Iraq, killed at least four people.
The blaze left 30 individuals injured.
Civil defense teams successfully brought the fire under control.

title: FBI, U.S. Agriculture Department breached by hackers, reports say
points: Hackers recently breached the systems of the FBI and the US Agriculture Department.
These attacks were identified as direct hacks rather than general system outages.
The breaches differ from previous technical issues at Microsoft and the FAA.

title: Pakistan Climate Minister arrives in Delhi to attend SCO Civilisations Dialogue Forum
points: Pakistan's Climate Minister is visiting Delhi for the SCO Civilisations Dialogue Forum.
The event is being held at the historic Purana Quila in New Delhi.
Pakistan holds the SCO Council of Heads of State chair for 2026-27.

title: What does EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan entail for retirees | Explained
points: The EPFO is considering a Systematic Withdrawal Plan for retirees.
This plan would allow members to receive their provident fund as periodic payments.
This serves as an alternative to taking the entire corpus as a single lump-sum.

title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
points: India's core sector growth reached a record 10.9% in October 2026.
The surge was largely driven by electricity and coal sectors.
Experts note the growth is partly due to a statistical 'low base effect' from previous months.

title: Coal auction rounds attract 85 bids; 20 first-time players enter sector
points: The 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions attracted 85 bids.
Twenty new companies entered the coal sector for the first time.
The auction included 25 blocks, with 21 fully explored and four partially explored mines.

title: CEA flags need to align capital markets with India’s development priorities
points: The Chief Economic Advisor stressed aligning capital markets with India's growth.
Equity market capitalization is currently at 130% of India's GDP.
The corporate bond market remains underdeveloped at only 16% of GDP.

title: How AI could reshape global growth and productivity
points: AI is expected to significantly increase global labor productivity.
Technological revolutions are measured by their ability to boost output per worker.
The ultimate impact of AI will depend on its adoption across different economic sectors.

title: Over 1 crore HPV vaccines given to 14-year-old girls in nine months: Health Ministry
points: The Health Ministry reported over 1 crore HPV vaccines given to 14-year-old girls.
The milestone was achieved in a period of nine months.
Six states, including Gujarat and Bihar, have reached 100% target coverage.

title: Pune startup develops atomic clock prototype amid growing export curbs on critical technologies
points: A Pune-based startup has developed an indigenous atomic clock prototype.
Atomic clocks are essential for GPS, satellite navigation, and strategic communications.
This development is crucial due to growing export curbs on high-end technologies.

title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ sets record with $3.79B in first-day retail sales, Rockstar Games reports
points: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' achieved a record $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales.
It is the latest title in the popular, open-world action game series.
The game is known for satirizing contemporary American culture.

title: Earthshot Prize finalists offer climate solutions for Mumbai, from wildfire detection to coastal protection and heat resilience
points: Earthshot Prize finalists proposed climate solutions for Mumbai.
Focus areas include wildfire detection, heat resilience, and coastal protection.
Experts suggest moving away from traditional infrastructure to protect waterfronts from rising seas.

title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of U.S. SEC investigation, sources say
points: The US SEC is investigating Nvidia's accounting practices.
The investigation is being conducted under the current US administration.
The SEC stated it will focus specifically on bread-and-butter securities fraud.

title: Jaydev Unadkat calls for balanced IPL pitches, says bowlers need an equal role
points: Cricketer Jaydev Unadkat urged for more balanced pitches in the IPL.
He emphasized that bowlers deserve an equal role in the game.
Unadkat secured a hat-trick for Saurashtra in a recent match against Delhi.

title: Not a fan of the Ballon d’Or, but Kane deserves it: Schmelzer
points: Footballer Marcel Schmelzer expressed his support for Harry Kane to win the Ballon d'Or.
He believes team achievements should be prioritized over individual awards.
Schmelzer is a former Borussia Dortmund full-back who trained under Jurgen Klopp.

title: IND vs NZ, 1st Test: India end Day 3 on 486/4, lead by 118
points: India finished Day 3 of the first Test against New Zealand at 486/4.
India holds a lead of 118 runs with two days left in the match.
The team scored 327 runs in 86 overs during the third day's play.

title: Perfect week caps Mirra Andreeva’s star-making year
points: Mirra Andreeva won the WTA Finals in Indian Wells.
The 19-year-old had a dominant performance against top-ranked players.
She also won her first Major title this year, signaling her potential for the future.

title: Pat Cummins wins Cricket Australia's ‘unanimous support’ to remain Test captain
points: Cricket Australia confirmed Pat Cummins will remain as the Test captain.
He received unanimous support from the cricket board.
Cummins has faced pressure regarding past ball-tampering controversies in 2018.
